description: return outside any procedure raises ol-return-outside-proc at the semantic stage (execute() now runs check() before Phase 2, so what is delivered is the semantic-stage copy of #114's semantic-stage rule, matching the established #94/#104 convention). Issue #97. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
